verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only Nix's own command set (nix-env, nix-shell, nix develop, nix search, nix run, nix build) and its declarative configuration.nix model. Nothing shows a compatibility layer, command aliases, or interface conventions carried over from an incumbent package manager, so a switcher would have to learn Nix's model. The axis applies to a package manager, but there is no evidence it is delivered.
